newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ConAgra up on strong EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ConAgra up on strong EPS.

text.p: ConAgra Inc shares traded up 1-1/8 at 50-1/8 on Thursday afternoon after the company reported strong second quarter earnings.
Earlier, ConAgra reported second quarter earnings of $0.82 a share, up from $0.72 a year ago.
"They were good quality earnings, up 14 percent, which was right in line with my estimate, but a penny better than concensus," Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said.
She added that ConAgra's grocery business, which accounts for 50 pecent of the company's earnings, showed "robust" growth.
